title: CSV 金额汇总
spec: Implement summarize(text: str) -> list[dict]. CSV header must contain customer,currency,amount (extra columns allowed). Strip customer, uppercase stripped currency (exactly three ASCII letters), parse finite Decimal amount (signed amounts allowed). Reject missing columns, empty customer, invalid currency, missing/invalid/nonfinite amount with ValueError; malformed row lengths also rejected. Aggregate by (customer,currency), output sorted by those keys, each dict customer,currency,total (Decimal rounded HALF_UP to 2 places as fixed string),count (int). Round only after summation. Empty/header-only CSV returns []. Do not use binary floats for money.

title: 区间合并缺陷修复
spec: Fix normalize(intervals) -> list[tuple[int,int]]. Input is an iterable of pairs of integers; booleans and nonintegers invalid. Each pair requires start < end, else ValueError. Sort and merge overlapping OR touching half-open ranges. Validate even ranges later swallowed by a merge. Accept generators. Never mutate caller data. Handle empty, negatives, duplicates and large input efficiently.

title: 确定性依赖调度
spec: Implement plan(graph: dict[str,list[str]]) -> list[str], where each node lists dependencies. All referenced nodes must exist or ValueError. Duplicate dependency entries count once. Always emit lexicographically smallest currently ready node (not sorting the final result). Cycles including self loops raise ValueError. Empty graph returns []; no mutation. Handle a 10000-node chain without recursion overflow; target O((V+E) log V).

title: TTL 与 LRU 缓存
spec: Implement Cache(capacity: int, clock: Callable[[],float]), positive integer capacity (bool invalid) else ValueError. put(key,value,ttl) sets expiry clock()+ttl; ttl <= 0 removes key. get(key,default=None) returns live value and refreshes LRU recency, expiration at now >= expiry. Updating an existing key refreshes value/expiry/recency. Expired entries must never evict a live entry; remove them before capacity eviction. __len__ counts only live entries. Use supplied clock, never sleep. Arbitrary hashable keys and None values supported; efficient repeated get at capacity 20000 (no full scan on every hit).

title: 有界异步映射
spec: Implement async bounded_map(func, items, limit) -> list. Await func(item) with at most limit concurrent calls; preserve input order, accept generator. limit must be positive int excluding bool, else ValueError (even empty input). On task error or caller cancellation, cancel and await all remaining workers; propagate original exception/cancellation. Do not leak tasks or swallow exceptions. Empty returns []. Use standard library only.

title: 原子 SQLite 迁移
spec: Implement migrate(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None for old users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,email TEXT NOT NULL). Normalize email strip().casefold(), deduplicate normalized emails keeping smallest id; add UNIQUE enforcement to email, set PRAGMA user_version=1. Empty/nonstring email is invalid: raise ValueError and roll back ALL changes including schema/version. Preserve unrelated tables and data. Version 1 rerun is idempotent; unsupported versions >1 raise ValueError. Connection must have no active transaction at entry; otherwise raise ValueError without altering caller transaction. Migration must be atomic, standard library only.

title: 流式 JSONL 命令行工具
spec: Implement process(source: TextIO,sink: TextIO) -> dict with accepted,invalid,ignored counts. Iterate lines (never source.read/readlines). Blank lines ignored; valid JSON object whose type is not sale ignored; malformed JSON or nonobject invalid. sale requires nonempty stripped customer str and amount integer >=0 (bool invalid). Aggregate accepted sales by customer then emit JSONL objects {customer,total,count} sorted customer, Unicode preserved. CLI python solution.py INPUT OUTPUT must run process on UTF-8 files, print stats JSON on stdout, exit 0; input/output resolving to same path rejected with nonzero exit before writing. Standard library only.

title: 安全 ZIP 解压
spec: Implement extract_safe(archive,destination) -> sorted list[str] of extracted file relative POSIX paths. Validate EVERY entry before creating/writing anything. Reject with ValueError: absolute path, Windows drive path, backslash, '..' segment, symlink ZIP member, duplicate normalized target, any existing target, total declared uncompressed size > 2 MiB. Directory entries allowed but omitted from returned files. Reject target that resolves outside destination (including preexisting parent symlink). Empty archive returns []. On validation failure destination stays unchanged. Valid UTF-8 names and nested dirs supported. Standard library only.

title: 确定性文本检索
spec: Implement rank(query: str, documents: dict[str,str], limit: int=10) -> list[tuple[str,int]]. Tokenize Unicode alphanumeric runs excluding underscore using regex [^\W_]+, casefold before tokenization. Query terms are deduplicated; a result must contain ALL terms. Score = sum document frequencies of each unique query term. Sort score descending then document id ascending. Empty query returns []; limit negative/noninteger/bool raises ValueError; zero returns []. Do not mutate documents. Support Unicode and large collections efficiently.

title: 分轮重试作业队列
spec: Implement run_jobs(jobs,handler,max_attempts) -> dict {results,attempts,failed}. Jobs iterable of unique string IDs; duplicate or nonstring IDs raise ValueError BEFORE any handler invocation. max_attempts positive integer excluding bool else ValueError. Execute round-robin: attempt 1 for all jobs in input order, then attempt 2 for retryable failures in same order, etc. handler(job_id,attempt) returns any value including None. ValueError is permanent, other Exception retries until max_attempts, BaseException propagates. results maps successes to value; attempts maps all ids to number executed; failed maps terminal failures to exception class name. Empty returns three empty dicts; no mutation; use no sleep.
